config.primary_metric: strict exact-match string equality on synth_test.jsonl

research_questions.question: Does the spherical cap loss improve the already-replicated original LLM-JEPA baseline?
research_questions.primary_contrast: Best completed cap variant minus original LLM-JEPA on matched seeds.
research_questions.decision_rule: Treat as promising only if the paired mean delta is positive and at least four of five seeds are non-negative.

research_questions.question: Does spherical noise help independently of anchor/view choice?
research_questions.primary_contrast: Noisy minus clean within the same frozen cap family: own_d1-own_d0, cross_d1-cross_d0, both_d1-both_d0.
research_questions.decision_rule: Noise is supported only by a positive paired mean in at least two families or one family with seed-level consistency.

research_questions.question: Is the useful target an own-view reconstruction, a cross-view prediction, or both?
research_questions.primary_contrast: cross_d1-own_d1 and both_d1-best(own_d1,cross_d1) on matched seeds.
research_questions.decision_rule: Prefer the simplest view target that improves exact match without hurting seed consistency.

research_questions.question: Do moving anchors avoid over-constraining generation, or do fixed anchors provide the better signal?
research_questions.decision_rule: Moving anchors are useful only if they recover exact match while preserving a positive or neutral cap effect.

research_questions.question: If cap variants underperform, is the failure due to cap-loss weight/schedule conflict rather than the spherical idea?
research_questions.primary_contrast: Follow-up lambda/schedule sweep for the least-bad cap family.
research_questions.decision_rule: Run lambda_cap in {0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5} and a delayed-cap schedule before rejecting the mechanism.

interpretation: Original LLM-JEPA is the replication gate: it is 18.25 pp over regular SFT on completed seeds.
Best completed cap variant so far is Co-trained Own D1 lambda 0.05 at 73.09%, with matched-seed delta 1.32 pp versus original LLM-JEPA.
Under the 4-of-5 seed-consistency rule, these cap variants can no longer pass on exact match: Own D0, Own D1, Cross D0, Cross D1, Both D0, Both D1, C Own, EMA Own, C Own D0 .05.
Own-view noise paired delta is -4.70 pp over 3 completed seeds.
Cross-view noise paired delta is 3.25 pp over 3 completed seeds.
Own+cross noise paired delta is -1.38 pp over 3 completed seeds.
Low-dose co-trained noise paired delta is 0.04 pp over 5 completed seeds.

next_experiments.name: Lambda-cap dose response
next_experiments.question: Is the cap loss useful only below lambda_cap=1.0?
next_experiments.design: Run Co-trained Own D1 lambda 0.05 at lambda_cap in {0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5} with the same five seeds and the same original LLM-JEPA protocol.
next_experiments.success_rule: A setting is credible only if its matched-seed delta versus original LLM-JEPA is non-negative and not driven by one seed.

next_experiments.name: Delayed or annealed cap schedule
next_experiments.question: Does the cap objective conflict with early language-model adaptation?
next_experiments.design: Hold lambda_cap=0 for epoch 1, then ramp to the selected lambda over epochs 2-4; compare against constant lambda on the same seeds.
next_experiments.success_rule: Schedule helps only if it improves exact match without erasing the noise/control contrast.

next_experiments.name: Geometry versus generation diagnostic
next_experiments.question: Are cap variants improving hidden-state geometry while hurting regex generation?
next_experiments.design: For SFT, original LLM-JEPA, and the best cap variant, extract text/code hidden states for a fixed 512-example test subset and plot PCA, cosine histograms, retrieval heatmaps, RankMe, and paired-vs-unpaired cosine.
next_experiments.success_rule: A geometry-only win is not sufficient; it just tells us whether the objective is doing the intended representation work.

next_experiments.name: Cross-view symmetry ablation
next_experiments.question: Is code-to-text reconstruction helpful or just extra pressure?
next_experiments.design: If cross_d1 beats own_d1, run a cross symmetric variant and compare text-to-code only versus text-to-code plus code-to-text.
next_experiments.success_rule: Keep symmetry only if exact match and seed consistency improve over the one-way cross variant.
